entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-12
entry.content:
Azure.ResourceManager.Compute.Recommender_1.1.0-beta.3

1.1.0-beta.3 (2026-11-12)

Features Added

  • Upgraded API version to 2026-10-05-preview.
  • Added regular compute placement scoring through GetComputePlacementScores(AzureLocation), which requires the scoring location. The new request and result models expose zonal scope as IsZonal.
  • Added ComputeRecommenderPlacementScore.PlacementPreference.

Other Changes

  • Upgraded Azure.Core from 1.62.0 to 1.64.0.

Azure.Security.KeyVault.Secrets_4.13.0-beta.1

4.13.0-beta.1 (2026-11-11)

Other Changes

  • Updated the Azure.Core dependency to 1.65.0, which includes the MSAL 4.92.0 update.

Azure.Security.KeyVault.Certificates_4.11.0-beta.1

4.11.0-beta.1 (2026-11-11)

Breaking Changes

  • Removed CertificateClientOptions.ServiceVersion.V2026_03_01_Preview. Use V2026_04_01 instead.

Bugs Fixed

  • Preserved the service version value shipped for 2026-04-01 in version 4.10.0.

Other Changes

  • Updated the Azure.Core dependency to 1.65.0, which includes the MSAL 4.92.0 update.

Azure.ResourceManager.RedisEnterprise_1.5.0-beta.1

1.5.0-beta.1 (2026-11-11)

Features Added

  • Updated the default service API version to 2026-10-01-preview.
  • Added cluster firewall rules for Azure Managed Redis. Use an empty array to clear rules; omit firewallRules on PATCH to leave them unchanged unless public network access is disabled.
  • Reintroduced custom Redis ACL access strings and provisioning error details to access policy assignments, previously available in 1.4.0-beta.2 but not in 1.4.0.

Azure.Provisioning.AppContainers_1.3.0

1.3.0 (2026-11-11)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version to 2026-07-01.
  • Added support for Container App private endpoint connections, Azure Functions, Dapr component resiliency policies, .NET components, label history, sandbox groups, and sandbox group virtual network connections.
  • Added support for managed environment migration eligibility checks and OpenTelemetry configuration.

Bugs Fixed

  • Corrected default names for Container Apps managed environments to use 2–60 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens.
    Expect automatically generated managed environment names to change when upgrading if explicit names are not set.

Other Changes

  • Migrated library generation to the TypeSpec provisioning emitter.

Azure.ResourceManager.Sovereign_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-11-11)

Features Added

This is the first preview release of the Microsoft Azure Sovereign management client library for .NET, generated from TypeSpec with API version 2026-10-31-preview.

  • Added SovereignViewResource and SovereignViewCollection to manage Sovereign views.
  • Added the CheckSovereignNameAvailability and CheckSovereignNameAvailabilityLocal operations.

Bugs Fixed

  • Expose RemediationId when a successful remediation long-running operation returns its action result in the ARM properties envelope. Flat responses and standard ARM polling, cancellation, and failure handling are unchanged.

Azure.Security.KeyVault.Administration_4.9.0-beta.5

4.9.0-beta.5 (2026-11-11)

Other Changes

  • Updated the Azure.Core dependency to 1.65.0, which includes the MSAL 4.92.0 update.

Azure.Security.KeyVault.Keys_4.11.0-beta.6

4.11.0-beta.6 (2026-11-11)

Other Changes

  • Updated the Azure.Core dependency to 1.65.0, which includes the MSAL 4.92.0 update.

Azure.Provisioning.PrivateDns_1.1.0-beta.1

1.1.0-beta.1 (2026-09-03)

Other Changes

  • Migrated generation to the TypeSpec-based provisioning generator.

Azure.ResourceManager.PrivateDns_1.3.0-beta.1

1.3.0-beta.1 (2026-10-19)

Features Added

  • Added support for API version 2026-06-01-preview, including querying Private DNS resource references.
  • Added TrafficManagementProfileId and read-only ProvisioningState to record data models.

Other Changes

  • Migrated the library generation from AutoRest to TypeSpec.
